title: Touring Italian hospitals and returning home in 1919
summary: The unit played the seven hospitals repeatedly, and he returned from Italy via France in October 1919 and rejoined Sam Morgan.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Yeah. We had seven hospitals to make. Oh, they went home? And we made them, made a, we'd go here one night and we'd go somewhere else the next night and we'd go around and around, you see? Yeah. Until we make the seven. Then we'd start back over again and make them, make them again. After all the boys was back home and I was still over there, then I got...

worrying about home. I want to come home. Well, that was up to me, you see. They told me, they said, when you get ready to go home, well, we let you go. And I left Italy and come to France in October, 1919. And I got the first vote out. I forgot what date it was, but anyhow, it was in October.
